svg.text: McCzarny recently adjusted cron schedules for
the Chromium Daily Digest to space out
generation tasks, with primary runs at 7:00 and
11:00 UTC and fallbacks at 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.
He also updated the LLM service to limit
generated summary points to a maximum of 25 for
more focused digests and increased the commits
fetch limit to 2000. Additionally, a feature
was added to hide the "go to next unread" toast
when a user scrolls to it. In the OpenCode
Sessions project, he updated the plugin to
correctly identify sessions awaiting user input
as "NEEDS INPUT" instead of "RUNNING" and
migrated the build process from Rollup to
esbuild for faster TypeScript transpilation,
resolving a build issue with TypeScript 7. He
also updated the README to clarify service
interaction and added a screenshot. For the
dcvis repository, he made wording fixes, added
"Trzebnica" DC, and updated information about
Piaseczno.
